apps.name: LocalGuard
apps.description: A root-free Android firewall that controls internet access per app using an on-device VPN, with locally saved rules and no remote VPN server.

apps.name: AppFin
apps.description: Force stop Android apps individually or in batches using Accessibility, with app exclusions, session results, and cancellation. No root or Shizuku required.

apps.name: Tellauncher
apps.description: A minimalist Android launcher with a quiet Home screen, searchable apps, custom shelves, and local settings backup. No accounts or internet required.

changelog: Improve internal organization by separating launcher screens, settings management, and app discovery.
Store screen navigation state using stable identifiers to prevent dependence on class or package names.
Safely reset incompatible temporary screen state after updating from older builds. Saved preferences, shelves, hidden apps, and protected app selections remain intact.
Add regression tests for app ordering, duplicate launcher entries, refresh cancellation, and saved-state handling.
Export and import settings, shelves, hidden apps, and protected app selections as JSON. App authentication must be re-enabled after import.
Drag to reorder custom shelves and optionally swipe between shelves in the drawer.
Tap a shelf to select it or use the pencil icon to edit.
More room for search results in the shelf editor, with Save and Delete icons in the top bar.
Show launcher Settings only in All apps, while keeping it searchable even when its visibility switch is off.
Change the default launcher even when Tellauncher is already the default.

apps.name: TellApps Shelf
apps.description: Browse Android apps, read release notes, download APKs, and open the Android installer. Includes offline catalog access, download management, and light or dark themes.

changelog: View installation status, available updates, and newer installed versions in the catalog and app details.
Open installed apps directly from their detail pages.
Check for TellApps Shelf updates from Settings and continue to release details for download and installation.
Read clearer release dates, APK sizes when available, and highlighted notes for the latest release.
Identify and clean up older APK files with confirmation while preserving active downloads and the latest versions.
Display bundled app icons, a refreshed Shelf launcher icon, Material navigation icons, and a rounded search field.
Browse and search the app catalog, view app details, and read release history.
Access the last synced catalog offline and refresh it manually.
Download APKs with progress, cancellation, retry, and download management.
Open the Android installer for downloaded APKs.
Choose system, light, or dark themes.
